facts.business: CIE Automotive India Limited manufactures automobile components including forgings, stampings, castings, and magnetic products.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure contracted but not recognized as liabilities

key_risks: Revenue recognition from sale of automobile components with significant related party transactions
Pending litigations with MSEDCL regarding Cross Subsidy Surcharge and Additional Surcharge
Contingent liabilities excluding consequential interest and penalties
facts.related_party_note: Extensive related party transactions with ultimate holding company CIE Automotive S.A., subsidiaries, fellow subsidiaries, associate companies, and Mahindra group entities. Loans to CIE Hosur Limited (Rs 749.52 Million) and CIE Aluminium Casting India Limited (Rs 730.00 Million) with interest income at 7.96%. Trade receivables from related parties of Rs 542.81 Million.
